notes: July 2023 college board-approved policy explicitly retains Wičhákini Owáyawa as a state-approved nonpublic school within the merged Wahóȟpi Kiŋ programme; students age 5+ in its immersion environment are school pupils. Current operator mission and 2024–25 calendar remain published; no ending indication found in checked sources. The 2016 preschool-only 100% sentence is not used as K evidence; the later 2023 policy independently describes the shared school-age immersion environment.
